lines.text: On that day the deaf will hear the scroll's words, and the humble will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
The ruthless will vanish and the mockers will disappear, and all who look for peace will be cut down.

wrong_details.wrong: all who look for peace will be cut down
wrong_details.true: all who look for evil will be cut down

lines.text: The LORD who redeemed Isaac says Jacob will be ashamed no longer, and the grumblers will accept instruction.
